_comment: DEGRADED 2026-08-10 ~11:00: boot-varying WORLD-Y (the known random-seed gotcha) shifts the camera height per launch, misaligning every horizontal edge between boots — measured 3.6-5.1% raw between two same-save launches after a night at 0.09-0.56% (that pair had drawn the same Y). Budgets below are TEMPORARY at 6.0 so the gate catches only gross breaks; the real fix is pinning or reading back world-Y in golden-capture (or a shift-tolerant compare) — top of the open findings list. The one-pixel control still proves the differ itself. Original calibration notes: maxDiffPct per pose = ~2x the measured two-run noise floor (2026-08-09: shop-floor 0.089, tools 0.22-0.56, stockroom 1.03). ignore rects mask measured nondeterminism that is not the subject: the window view of animated outdoor content, and the loose boxes whose landing spots vary per boot. stockroom-wall needs better masks - budget is wide until then. 2026-08-10 second calibration: the lower window half is the LIVE COURSE (golfers/carts vary per boot) and the loose box can topple and scatter wider than it stands - both masked full-extent.
